Main atlas ↗Rankings workbook ↗All metrics CSV ↗

This companion view adds two new ways to explore the Parkway shapes: a fingerprint/similarity finder that compares the geometry of each selected path, and a ranking mode that sorts the full collection by individual measurements.

Similarity is based on normalized shape traces plus summary metrics. Rankings are within this selected-path study; they are not a complete inventory of every possible physical ramp or driving movement on the Parkway.

How to read the rankings

Some categories are “bigger is more” and others are “smaller is more.” Tightest local bend, for example, ranks the smallest modeled radius highest. Shortest selected segment may identify a feeder or fork rather than a full entry/exit route.

NJDOT centerlines snapshot: 2025-08-21. Similarity and ranking calculations are derived from the selected-path study and are best used as editorial comparison tools, not as engineering design values or current-condition surveys.
